implementation_notes: Document explicitly states it has no binding or compulsory force ('法的その他いかなる意味においても拘束力・強制力を持つものではない'). It is a practical handbook for generative AI adoption in the child and family services domain, based on pilot project findings as of March 31, 2025. Recommends human oversight of all AI outputs, compliance with personal information protection laws, and staff literacy training. Encourages referencing related ministry guidelines before adoption.
